runtime_secret_state_inventory.boundary: the smaller shared kernel runtime now owns the boxed fixed-size slot file, confidential-argument staging, live slot-word accounting, and wipe-on-drop semantics through a Lean-generated slot-support module plus the private RuntimeKernelSlotCall adapter, while uo-core only provides the generated slot-program interpreter and exact-size hash-part buffer; uo-evm reaches that state only through RuntimeKernelMachine and no longer exposes a uo-core slot-state wrapper or call executor surface

runtime_secret_state_inventory.boundary: secret-bearing committed/shadow object maps stay inside crate::runtime, with distinct public and confidential shadow wrappers delimiting the shell boundary, a boxed fixed-order object table, and exact-size boxed builders instead of growable transient entry vectors on the confidential path

runtime_secret_state_inventory.boundary: shared hidden ORAM witness snapshot wrapper built only from state.rs through the shared exact-size CommittedRuntimeWitnessSnapshotBuilder, stored in boxed fixed-size buffers for the public-bounded ORAM witness set, kept by a runtime that can export a call's evidence from one call to the next, moved there by each call's leaf transitions and compared with the decode of the store before and after every call, copied only by its duplicate method, used otherwise only to assemble traced-call start/outcome/witness handoff bundles, and wiping those hidden witness buffers on drop; a production runtime builds and keeps none

runtime_secret_state_inventory.boundary: direct seal/open stays in codec; the deterministic unit codec helpers (one nonzero marker byte in each 32-byte unit of a record) live in a Lean-generated codec fragment, the exact-size plaintext staging and wipe-on-drop shell now live in the Lean-generated surface fragment, and the handwritten codec shell is reduced to key lifecycle plus public delegating methods; the fixed-size raw/UO slot stores keep their ciphertext cells in boxed buffers via Lean-generated raw-slot allocation and copy-and-wipe helpers while the UO bootstrap/write path is forced through Lean-generated boxed-filler and seal-into helpers and records only public update-shape write evidence rather than cloning ciphertext snapshots
